Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya, *The sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a graph 4-invariant*. Revision of 30 October 2026, single column (amsart), 13 pages.

The paper proves the conjecture of Fomichev, Karev, Pavutnitskiy and Usanov (arXiv:2607.24217,
Section 4): the specialisation of the sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a 4-invariant
of graphs, xi(G) = (-32)^{-n} S_G(-2), where S_G(N) counts with signs the maps sending the
n vertices of G to 2-element subsets of {1, ..., N}.

New in this revision (Section 7, proved by hand): for every N the element of a chord diagram
built from so(N) acts on the spin representation by the scalar (-4)^{-n} S_G(N), so the spin
weight system of so(N) extends to a graph 4-invariant. At N = 3 this gives w_D(3/8) =
8^{-n} S_G(3), the colouring invariant phi of Fomichev and Karev, a direct proof that phi
extends the weight system at c = 3/8. With the Killing form the spin weight system is
(8(N-2))^{-n} S_G(N), and the main theorem is its value at N = -2.

Programs in Python, Julia, C and C++ check the identities of the paper on small cases; this
release runs all of them before publishing. No statement of the paper rests on them.

This revision replaces v1.0.2 and its Hexagon version hexagon:2610.00320v2; the earlier
versions are archived on Zenodo under the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23312529.

Files: the paper (`Sl2WeightSystemAtMinus3Over32_final2.pdf`), its LaTeX source with the
figures (`Sl2WeightSystemAtMinus3Over32_final2-tex.zip`) and the arXiv tarball
(`Sl2WeightSystemAtMinus3Over32_final2-arxiv.tar.gz`).
